result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but a few visual issues stand out: horizontally scrollable rows (category chips and 'Fastest near you' cards) are clipped at the right edge without clear scroll affordance, and the bottom navigation 'Orders' tab lacks an icon unlike its siblings, creating an inconsistent tab bar.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards and the category filter chips are cut off at the right screen edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' and a partial chip), with no visible scroll indicator or gradient hint that more content exists horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade/gradient or scroll indicator, and ensure card widths/spacing make it obvious the row is horizontally scrollable. Also truncate long restaurant names with an ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab has only a text label and no icon, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' each have icons, making the tab bar look unbalanced and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add a matching line-style icon (e.g. a receipt or bag icon) above the 'Orders' label to align with the other tabs.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated mid-word without a clear ellipsis, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccol…') and ensure adequate card width so names are readable.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right relies only on a small red dot to convey unread notifications, which may be hard to perceive for users with low vision or color-vision deficiencies.
issues.suggestion: Add a numeric badge or ensure the dot meets minimum touch/visibility size and contrast, and provide an accessible label for the bell button.
